takes.sourceDescription: B sits; A pulls up B (subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Rise with partner's help, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B starts seated with a leg extended, reaches out and rises with a forward lean, then settles standing.

takes.sourceDescription: A sits; B pulls up A (subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Pull seated partner up, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B walks forward, reaches down and draws the hands toward the body while stepping and turning, then lowers the arms.

takes.sourceDescription: A sits, holds face in hands; B kneels, comforts A (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Kneel and comfort, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B reaches forward, lowers onto one knee with a hand extended, then rises and steps back.

takes.sourceDescription: B comforts A, puts one hand on A's shoulder (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Comfort partner at shoulder, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B steps, raises one hand and leans to the side with the arm extended, then straightens slightly.

takes.sourceDescription: A comforts B, puts both hands on B's shoulders (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Receive two-handed comfort, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B starts upright, lowers the head and shoulders, then gradually raises the head while standing.

takes.sourceDescription: B comforts A, puts both hands on A's shoulders (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Comfort partner at shoulders, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B steps and raises both hands forward at shoulder level, holds the reach and then lowers the arms.

takes.sourceDescription: A comforts B, puts one hand on B's shoulder (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Receive shoulder comfort, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B stands with arms lowered and head tilted down, making small posture shifts.

takes.sourceDescription: hold hands, swing arms, walk (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Hold hands and walk, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B walks with one arm swinging outward and across the body, continuing alternating steps through the end.

takes.sourceDescription: A gives B a shoulder rub; B sits, A stands (subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Receive shoulder rub, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B sits with hands near the lap, inclines the head and torso, then lifts slightly while remaining seated.

takes.sourceDescription: A shelters B, a younger child, from harm (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Sheltered child, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B starts standing, bends the knees and leans forward with arms held out, then straightens near the end.

takes.sourceDescription: B shelters A, a younger child, from harm (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Shelter a child, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B widens the stance, spreads the arms and leans sideways, then shifts back toward upright with arms still out.

takes.sourceDescription: A stumbles into B (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Partner stumbles into participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B takes small walking steps, turns the head and shoulders and remains upright through the end.

takes.sourceDescription: A passes soda to B; both drink (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Receive soda and drink, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B extends a hand, brings both hands toward the chest and raises a hand to the mouth, then lowers it.

takes.sourceDescription: alternating squats (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Alternating squats, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B starts in a knee bend, repeats deep squats separated by upright pauses and begins to rise at the end.

takes.sourceDescription: alternating jumping jacks (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Alternating jumping jacks, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B repeats jumps into a wide stance with arms overhead, then lowers the arms and settles upright.

takes.sourceDescription: synchronized jumping jacks (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Synchronized jumping jacks, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B repeats jumps into a wide stance with arms overhead, returning arms and legs between repetitions and ending upright.

takes.sourceDescription: rush up, arm wrestle (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Arm wrestle, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B starts bent forward with one forearm raised, shifts in a wide stance, leans down and sideways, then straightens.

takes.sourceDescription: A stares down B, leans with hands on high stool (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Seated stare-down, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B remains seated, leans back with legs spread and hands near the lap, and finishes seated.

takes.sourceDescription: B stares down A, leans with hands on high stool (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Stand and lean on stool, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B begins seated, rises into a wide stance and leans forward with hands down, remaining bent through the end.

takes.sourceDescription: violence - A picks up high stool, threatens to strike B (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: React to raised stool, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B begins seated, leans sharply sideways and backward, raises an arm toward the head and braces low through the end.

takes.sourceDescription: conversation - B pounds high stool, points at A (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Pound stool and point, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B sits, lifts both hands in a brief forward gesture, then lowers them and remains seated.

takes.sourceDescription: walk; B catches keys thrown by A (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Catch keys while walking, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B starts with hands together near the chest and continues walking as the arms lower.

takes.sourceDescription: walk; A catches keys thrown by B (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Throw keys while walking, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B walks with arms near the body, continuing alternating steps through the end.
takes.reviewNote: Source identifies a key throw; the object and release are not discernible in the sheet.

takes.sourceDescription: walk; B catches wallet thrown by A (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Catch wallet while walking, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B begins with hands raised and together, brings them toward the torso and continues walking.

takes.sourceDescription: walk; A catches wallet thrown by B (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Throw wallet while walking, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B continues alternating walking steps with arms near the body and ends mid-stride.
takes.reviewNote: Source identifies a wallet throw; the object and release are not discernible in the sheet.
